findings.title: Successful diarization rerun replaces previous manual speaker names
findings.rationale: Both analysis result constructors initialize speaker_names empty. Background worker puts that result with INSERT OR REPLACE, so previous names_json is replaced before success polling rereads DB.
findings.counterevidence: Failure path does not intentionally replace a good row. Mapping old speaker identities to new segments is not trivial and requires product policy rather than blind name merge.
findings.verification: source_inspection and actual migration INSERT OR REPLACE in Python SQLite 3.45.1; native_rerun_not_run
findings.remaining_check: Exact-binary rename then rerun fixture; decide stable-speaker identity/remap or explicit reset warning before implementation.

findings.title: meeting:ending is a visual hint, not automatic session stop
findings.rationale: Meeting-ending detection emits event and UI changes pill only. Worker stop range previously cited is unrelated macOS capture watchdog.
findings.remaining_check: Confirm expected UX in actual session; no automatic-stop feature is claimed from this event.

findings.title: Candidate approval omits V2 provenance fields from new item
findings.rationale: Approval copies profile/kind/text/source_session_id only; source_text/entity/norm_status remain on approved candidate but new memory item defaults null/none. Structured normalization provenance is not copied by current legacy approve API.
findings.counterevidence: Current automatic normalizer caller not found; typical heuristic candidates have defaults anyway. Direct manually inserted NewMemoryItem can preserve supplied V2 fields.
findings.verification: source_inspection and matching SQL projection executed in Python SQLite 3.45.1; native UI approval not_run
findings.remaining_check: Exact-SHA candidate with V2 provenance approve fixture; decide whether preserving normalization lineage is expected and migration-safe.
